newsitem.title: USA: Respironics files patent suit vs Healthdyne.
newsitem.headline: Respironics files patent suit vs Healthdyne.

text.p: Respironics Inc said Friday it filed a patent infringement lawsuit against Healthdyne Technologies Inc, alleging unlawful use of its patented bi-level technology.

Respironics said it pioneered in the technology through its portable Bipap medical device, one version of which is used in ventilating a patient's lungs and another version to help patients with sleep disorders. Respironics said it seeks injunctive relief, damages for prior allegedly infringing sales of Healthdyne's Quantum and Tranquility Bilevel devices and special damages for alleged willful infringement.
